extraction_scope: Local saved product/catalog/quote evidence only; no network calls, Shopify reads/writes, app collection, or scheduler invocation.
timestamps: ISO timestamps are UTC. Source embedded timestamps are used because copied/migrated file modification times are not evidence of collection time.

status.current_running_status: not checked; no worker or device was started

older_worker_state.note: Older than independent audit; its counts are not used as the latest snapshot.

important_limits: 544 acquired catalog records means card identity/image capture, not 544 completed fresh price checks or listings.
All 120 mappings are historical saved snapshots; current Shopify price, availability and completeness were not refreshed for this handoff.
All 10 samples reproduce the current-model formula used in their historical records. All quote timestamps are stale for execution on the handoff date.
Minimum asking prices are app_unfiltered_version_minimum; condition, genuine purchase availability and source-card variant accuracy need further review.
Matching arithmetic is not proof of a fair selling price. No sample is asserted to be a confirmed wrong price.
The RMB 85 allowance is embedded separately in every listed unit, so low-value cards cluster near USD 25-27. Order-level shipping/profit modeling remains a review topic.
Historical readback files often omit their own timestamp. Completion time and supporting audit time are separate fields and are not claimed to be fresh readback times.
Raw app screenshots and raw capture UI data are not included. Recorded evidence hashes and repository-relative source pointers are provided for traceability.
These exports are review data, not executable mapping configuration or authorization to update prices.

validation.input_hash_checks: All supplied historical expected hashes checked for audited readback inputs; every input used has a newly computed SHA-256 in provenance.json.
